mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing during a recession, which reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate was 0.22% as of 2009-02-01
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity market expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the signal fails to generate a negative return distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (as proxied by RSAFS) indicates a collapse in private demand, which signals deepening economic contraction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 466.0K in Jan 2009, RSAFS was 346.8B in Feb 2009
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a severe supply-side contraction, which reflects a deep economic downturn and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 90.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a contraction in GDP (GDPC1) signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which triggers equity market pessimism and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 was 11525.0B in Oct 2008, RSAFS was 346.8B in Feb 2009
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% per annum, combined with a stagnant or declining federal funds rate, signals a loss of central bank control over inflation expectations, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the interaction effect IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market collapse, which signals a deepening recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS was 133768K in Feb 2009, UNRATE was 8.1%
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 5-day SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential construction starts (HOUST) below 500K units signals a collapse in housing demand, which reduces confidence in the broader economy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate eventual policy intervention and recovery.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST < 500.0, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
